verdict.rationale: Dropbox is a cloud storage service that ships AI features (Dash, AI summarization, integrations with AI tools), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The pack only describes those AI features and says nothing about a setting, policy or commitment that keeps user data out of model training. Off-topic community privacy and security complaints were ignored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
